content.prompt: For a dataset that is normally distributed, find the probability that a randomly chosen score has a z-score as follows. Use the standard normal table and give probabilities to 4 decimal places.

spec.description: Unshaded normal-curve response scaffold with a horizontal axis, arrowheads at both ends and only a central tick labelled zero. The source orange curve uses ordinary black under house style.
spec.mathematics: Standard normal bell curve centred at zero; no interval boundaries or shaded answer region supplied.
